2075,2076,2077,2078,2079,2080,2081,2082,2083,2084 |id2 = 7252 |id3 = 7251 }} '''Fire giants''' are powerful [[Giant (race)|giants]] that are popular for training [[Ranged]] and [[Slayer]]. They are also the strongest of the standard giants, being significantly stronger than their [[Ice giant|Ice]], [[Moss giant|Moss]], and [[Hill giant]] relatives. Fire giants are assigned by a multitude of [[Slayer Master]]s, providing fairly decent experience for both [[combat]] and Slayer. They're also frequently killed by [[Ironman]] players early on due to their signature [[rune scimitar]] drop, as they are fairly easy to access with numerous [[safespot]]s. Although there are many locations where [[dwarf multicannon|cannons]] can be used, only the [[Charred Dungeon]] spawns are in a [[multicombat area]]. ==Locations== {{LocTableHead}} {{LocLine |name =
